projection.note: Projection uses the largest measured page in each family and accounts for workspace/.next plus out copies. Unseen larger histories or compiler growth can exceed it; runtime disk monitoring remains enabled.

preflight.note: Same-source sample projection checked; the build also stops if the reserve is crossed.

summary.note: Observation timestamps record when the OS query ran, not when a log marker occurred. Compile/type/render-start marker snapshots were caught up after observer resume during rendering; their occurrence times are unknown. Boundary sampling cannot rule out transient pressure between observations. The RSS value is the sampled sum for hooked child Node processes and their Node descendants; it excludes the build wrapper parent, pnpm, native subprocesses, and short-lived peaks, and is not the total-system RAM peak. Pre-existing warning and global paging are not uniquely attributable to this build.

wrapperPointObservation.note: Read-only ps point sample during finalization/verification; exact timestamp was not captured. This value is not a peak and is not added to the child-process RSS peak.

benchmark.selectionRule: Among verified candidates within 5% of the fastest median next-build time, prefer the lowest sampled peak RSS; then the lower time.

cacheSeed.copyMethod: Filesystem clone when supported; ordinary copy otherwise. Only compiler/typecheck cache is restored.

cold.cacheCondition: workspace/.next removed; compiler filesystem cache enabled so the run also creates the common cache seed

controlledComparison.note: Separate timing control, without changing matrix selection. Source, snapshot, input bytes, runtime, worker settings, and restored compiler cache are identical to inline3. OS background pressure/paging remains uncontrolled and is observed before/after each control run. Root out is now an optimized sample; a fresh full build is still required before upload.
